caption: The drawing depicts a stylized arrangement centered within a square bordered by several rectangular frames in shades of red, teal, gray, and black. In the center of the composition, there is a vertical, cylindrical, light blue vase or pedestal with a scrolled, decorative collar in red and black. Emerging from the top of the vase is a yellowish bundle resembling a sheaf of wheat, with individual grain heads spreading outward and upward. The immediate background behind the vase and bundle is a pinkish-red square field bordered by a thick black line with undulating, wavy black lines along the inner edge, set against a wider border of alternating red and green bands. The entire composition is set on a plain, off-white background.
title: Companion Panel from Main Reredos, Church of Sanctuario, Chimayo
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
